Remap interpolates assuming segment entries ascend by fromCoordinate; a
hostile or corrupt map with descending entries produced wrong (although
bounded) remappings. Validate monotonicity at load and degrade such an
axis to the identity mapping, keeping the reader aligned for the
remaining axes. Degenerate equal-from segments stay tolerated - Remap
handles them
